notes: All assertions and planned paths are future implementation/test work. This JSON syntax/ID validation is an artifact check only; no Events coverage pass, test execution, real provider verification or app/Clip build is claimed.

L01–L03 each cover exactly five named origin variants. L04–L11 run on app, Clip and browser where available. L17 compares nine explicit states. Do not multiply the inventory into an unexecuted exhaustive-combinations claim.

Use isolated Event A/public place and Event H/consented home, canonical fixture accounts, controlled clocks, test phone numbers and provider test identities. No real attendee messages, live events or production identity changes.
Existing evidence entries are adjacent regression seams or source constraints, never implemented Events coverage. No existing test is presumed passed in this review.

Native state/repository tests use deterministic fakes and URLProtocol; host XCUITests exercise actual app/Clip views and transitions. Guest-web Playwright needs a new harness, stubbed-state mode and a separate controlled-service integration mode. Provider OAuth and install/public invocation remain physical-device checks.

Backend ownership/RLS, seat/code concurrency and outbox deduplication assertions require the data/rules package’s authoritative service oracle. Stubbed UI/browser responses cannot satisfy those assertions; map shared case IDs to the service test ledger during integration.

P01 auth-interruption interaction, P02 SMS timings, P11 post-expiry presentation, P13 later general-onboarding resumption and P19 unavailable presentation retain their proposal status.
